headline: Supreme Petrochem to invest ₹450 crore in new mABS production line

modes.bear: The long lead time until 2028 means capital is tied up for years before contributing to the bottom line.
modes.bull: Doubling mABS capacity to 140 KTPA positions the company to capture growing demand for specialty plastics over the next four years.
modes.simple: Supreme Petrochem is spending ₹450 crore to build a new factory line for specialty plastics. It will take until 2028 to finish, but it will double their ability to produce this specific material.

summary: Supreme Petrochem has signed a technology agreement with Italy's Versalis to establish a second 70 KTPA mABS production line. The ₹450 crore project aims to double the company's total mABS capacity to 140 KTPA. Mechanical completion of the facility is scheduled for December 2028. This expansion strengthens the company's position in the specialty polymers market.
why_it_matters: Long-term production capacity growth signals potential for higher future revenue.

headline: Supreme Petrochem reports strong revenue growth for September quarter

modes.bear: High revenue growth does not guarantee profitability; rising input costs could still compress margins despite the top-line expansion.
modes.bull: The massive 77.86% year-on-year sales growth indicates strong market demand and successful scaling of operations for the company.
modes.simple: Supreme Petrochem saw its sales grow by nearly 78% compared to last year. This means the company is selling significantly more products, which is generally a positive sign for a business's health.

summary: Supreme Petrochem reported standalone net sales of Rs 1,956.70 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. This represents a 77.86% increase compared to the same period last year. The company's performance reflects significant year-on-year revenue expansion. Retail investors can assess this growth against the company's historical margins and broader chemical sector trends.
why_it_matters: Strong revenue growth may signal improved demand for petrochemical products.

headline: Supreme Petrochem posts strong Q2 growth and declares interim dividend
hook: Profit nearly doubles on surging revenue
summary: Supreme Petrochem reported a 77.8% year-on-year rise in revenue to ₹1,956.7 crore for Q2 FY27. Profit after tax nearly doubled to ₹94.9 crore during the quarter. The company also declared a first interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share for FY27. October 30 has been set as the record date for this payout. Indian retail shareholders in the company will receive the dividend if they hold the stock by the record date.
whats_next: Record date on October 30 for interim dividend
why_it_matters: Interim payout and strong earnings boost shareholder returns
winners_losers: Supreme Petrochem shareholders gain / competitors neutral
